name: PIC24FJ1024GB610
description: Microchip PIC24FJ1024GB610: a 16-bit PIC24F core at up to 16 MIPS (32 MHz), 1 MiB of dual-partition program flash, 32 KiB of RAM, USB OTG, six UARTs, the Peripheral Pin Select; the Explorer 16/32's PIC24 PIM (MA240023).

memory.name: flash
memory.doc: Program memory, program addresses 0x000000 to 0x0ABFFF: each 24-bit word at twice its address, in four bytes (the low, middle and high bytes and a phantom 0), as an XC16 image lays it out; the configuration words in the last page (FSEC 0x0ABF00 to FDEVOPT1 0x0ABF2C)

memory.name: ram
memory.doc: Data RAM, data addresses 0x0800 to 0x87FF (EmbSIM's bus puts the data space at 0x2000000); above 0x8000 it is EDS page 1, through DSRPAG and DSWPAG

sources.name: hse
sources.doc: The primary oscillator: the board's crystal on OSCI/OSCO (8 MHz on the Explorer 16/32's PIM)

sources.name: sosc
sources.doc: The secondary oscillator, a 32.768 kHz crystal on SOSCI/SOSCO

functional.claims: PIC24F execution by the core extracted from EmbCC (every instruction the 16-bit reference manual gives the PIC24F, the addressing modes, REPEAT and the iterative divide, the Extended Data Space and program space visibility, the table reads, the traps and the interrupts through the vector table, DISI, PWRSAV); every special function register of the device pack's EDC with its power-on value; behavioural models of the interrupt controller (priorities, natural order, INTTREG, the trap flags, NSTDIS), the oscillator (FNOSC from the configuration words, OSCCON's unlock sequences, the switch, the PLL's 32 MHz and CPDIV) with the PPS lock (IOLOCK, IOL1WAY), Timer1 to Timer5 (prescalers, 32-bit pairs, TMRxHLD), ports A to G (TRIS, LAT, ODC, ANS, the pulls, the interrupt-on-change) and UART1 to UART6 (4-deep buffers, the interrupt selections, frames at the baud rate on the pins the PPS gives them).
omissions: the ADC, SPI, I2C, input capture, output compare, the MCCP and SCCP modules, the EPMP, the RTCC, DMA, USB, the comparators, the CRC, the CLCs, the CTMU, HLVD and the reference clock (plain registers)
the watchdog and deep sleep (it never resets the part)
flash programming (NVM) and the dual partitions
the PLL's other modes (4x, 6x, 8x: FOSC is 32 MHz divided by CPDIV) and the DCO
the dsPIC's DSP instructions (the core's dsPIC33E mode is not used by this part)

timed.claims: Instruction cycles as the reference manual gives them (one; two for a taken branch, GOTO, CALL and the table instructions; three for RETURN and RETFIE; five for an exception's entry); the timers count FCY with their prescalers and the UARTs FCY / (16 or 4 x (BRG + 1)) exactly.
omissions: the oscillator's start-up and the PLL's lock time
interrupt latency beyond the instruction in progress

electrical.claims: GPIO pin-model defaults at 3.3 V from the data sheet's DC characteristics (VOH 2.4 V, VOL 0.4 V, VIH 0.8 VDD, VIL 0.2 VDD, the weak pulls).
omissions: drive strength beyond one output resistance
